checkpoint.encoding: canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON; exact field set
checkpoint.key: externally pinned 44-byte SPKI DER with exact log identity and validity

merkle.profile: RFC6962 domain-separated binary Merkle tree inclusion and consistency

consistency.configuration: optional immutable checkpoint floor bound into verifier policy
consistency.verification: RFC6962 consistency proof from the configured old root to every supplied newer checkpoint

witness.statement_encoding: canonical sorted compact UTF-8 JSON; exact field set
witness.quorum: immutable integer 1..number of distinct configured witness identities
witness.duplicate_identity_vote: reject even when multiple rotation keys are configured
witness.invalid_supplied_proof: reject; never ignore to satisfy quorum
witness.effective_expiry: minimum of checkpoint, log key, witness statement and witness key expiries

policy.required_mode: fixed immutable configuration; missing proof rejects
policy.optional_mode: only wholly absent proof may pass; supplied evidence is fully checked
policy.legacy_binding: unchanged when no consistency anchor or witness policy is configured

registry.stored_installation_expiry: minimum of consent, manifest and all verified transparency authority expiries

platform.verification_runtime: trusted absolute system OpenSSL, sanitized environment

not_provided: manifest submission or authenticated proof retrieval
persisted latest-checkpoint service or cross-client gossip
proof that configured witness operators are independent
claim_ceiling: Admission-time validation of one signed inclusion proof, optional consistency from one pinned floor and a configured witness-signature quorum. Not operated/global log honesty, witness independence, product qualification or full HG-0087/skills closure.
